fields.Incident Title: 80HSM R3 Top Roll Balance Carrier Beam Incident
fields.Object Caused: R3 Top Roll Balance Exit Carrier Beam and Link
fields.Incident Desc: At approximately 13:03 R3 Exit Carrier Beam fell into the R3 Mill Pit onto the sled and a scaffold platform. No Team members were working in the pit at the time. However, several contractor employees were in the pit throughout the morning. Two Contractor employees walked next to the Roughing mill stand witnessing the delivery carrier beam falling from the yoke in the mill. Area was red flagged off for a further investigation. The delivery carrier beam and link were intact with keeper still installed. There appeared to be no damage on the yoke on top of the mill stand, which the link rests on. There was a small mill window liner from the top operator side that fell with the carrier beam. There were no crane lifts at the time or prior involving this equipment. The work rolls, top and bottom backup were removed on the previous shift in preparation for outage work in the mill stand. R3 top backup roll balance was left isolated in the up (raised) position. B hydraulics was shutoff and bled prior to this for work on that particular system.
fields.Preliminary Cause: Roughing Mill R3 Carrier Beam became dislodged from Balance Beam Cylinder Yoke.
fields.Immediate Corrective Action: Stopped all work in area. Red flagged off area where Carrier Beam Fell, Inspect all other Mills for similar situation and ensured all stands had top roll balance in the lowered position, verified status of link arm keepers being present in all other mill stands, had safety stand down with all parties involved with work in the area.
fields.Document Review: Mechanical Drawings, ECP, Lockout verification, Video, Pictures and Measurements.
